item.title: The Beach Boys’ Official Online Store Drops ‘Pet Sounds’ 60th-Anniversary Merch & Apparel: Shop Now
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the world of music and merchandise. Today, we're celebrating a milestone - the 60th anniversary of The Beach Boys' iconic album, Pet Sounds. Released in 1966, this album remains a classic, and to commemorate this occasion, the band is releasing new merch and apparel.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: "Whether you're a longtime fan or just discovered the album, you can show off your love for Pet Sounds with a range of items, from T-shirts to tote bags. The Beach Boys have an official store on Amazon, featuring logo apparel, sweatshirts, and more. You can even get stylish Beach Boys tote bags for just $24.99.
[Music transitions to a few seconds of "Pet Sounds" audio clip]
Host: "On Amazon, you can find a variety of Beach Boys gear, including a 'Pet Sounds' 1966 T-shirt for $24, a 'Wouldn't It Be Nice' jersey for $29, and a 'Pet Sounds' nylon coaches jacket for $149. There are also exclusive items like a 'Pet Sounds' flamingo T-shirt and a 'Pet Sounds' giraffe tote bag.
[Music transitions back to soft background music]
Host: "If you're interested in learning more about the making of Pet Sounds, there's a documentary from 2002 that features interviews with Brian Wilson, Mike Love, and Al Jardine. You can buy it on Blu-ray for $11 or stream it on Prime Video for $4.99.
[Music transitions to a few seconds of "Pet Sounds" audio clip]
Host: "As an Amazon Prime member, you can get any of these merch items delivered to your home in under two days with Prime Delivery. Not a member? You can sign up for a 30-day free trial to take advantage of all that Amazon Prime has to offer, including access to Amazon Music, Prime Video, and more.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. If you're looking for more great deals and merchandise, be sure to check out our roundups of the best Xbox deals, studio headphones, and Nintendo Switch accessories. Happy shopping, and we'll catch you in the next episode!"
